‘RHOA’ star Porsha Williams announces engagement to girlfriend Patrice ‘Sway’ McKinney

By
Riley Cardoza
Published Nov. 25, 2026, 8:04 a.m. ET

See more of our coverage in your search results.

Porsha Williams is engaged — again.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 11:13
Instaread

The “Real Housewives of Atlanta” star revealed her girlfriend, Patrice “Sway” McKinney, proposed in an Instagram video posted Tuesday.

“I said YES💍,” the Bravolebrity, 45, told her followers, confirming the couple reached the relationship milestone on Saturday.

Explore More

Porsha Williams lifts lid on Erin Lichy and Dorinda Medley’s unseen ‘RHUGT’ fight

Porsha Williams dishes on ‘RHUGT’ unseen moments and teases the new season of ‘RHOA’

‘RHUGT’ recap: Luann calls out Porsha for being 2 hours late, the cast confronts the Countess

Williams, who shut down engagement speculation earlier this year, concluded by writing to her now-fiancée, “I love you forever @sway_thepro.”

McKinney, in her own post, gushed, “Engaged. 11/21/26 #IssaFiancee ❤️ I love you! Porsha Williams.”

In the emotional footage, the couple kissed in coordinating diamond-encrusted black outfits while debuting the reality star’s massive ring.

Bravo exec Andy Cohen commented on the social media upload with multiple heart emojis, with many of Williams’ co-stars weighing in as well.

“Congratulations FRICK & @sway_thepro‼️” Phaedra Parks wrote. “I knew forever was inevitable for y’all! The way you love each other is unmatched! Can’t wait for the wedding 💒 May this type of love and ring find me 😜✅ MY GIRL STAY WINNING 🏆”

Kandi Burruss shared her “congratulations,” and Cynthia Bailey wished the “deserving” couple “love, peace & happiness.”

Williams revealed at New York City’s CultureCon in October 2025 that she was dating a woman.

Although she did not name McKinney at the time, Internet sleuths identified Williams’ partner — and the pair made their romance Instagram-official the following month.

Williams has been married twice before to former NFL player Kordell Stewart and businessman Simon Guobadia.

Join the Conversation
Have your say.Share your thoughts in the comments below.

Between her marriages, the former “Dish Nation” host got engaged to Dennis McKinley, with whom she shares 7-year-old daughter Pilar.

Williams made it clear to People in June that she would “absolutely marry again” despite her failed unions.

“It’s lonely,” she confessed to the outlet at the time. “I’m sitting there like, ‘Do I like women enough? Can I get with a woman? Who can come in and fill this void?'”
